intro.text: A darkeyed chef in the kitchens of the citylord's mansion in Hearthstone.

items.text: Barm was head chef for Citylord Wistiow, and Roshone kept him on after Wistiow's death. When Lirin came to discuss the spheres Wistiow had left him and sent Kaladin to the kitchens, Barm knew at once why the boy was there and had a servant bring him flatbread and fruited tallew rice.

appearance.text: A tall, slender man with dark hair worn in a braid.

personality.text: Experienced and used to feeding children, he walks his kitchen line banging a long metal spoon on a pot whenever he gives an order.
